## How to get & run it

You need R (≥ 4.5) and RStudio.

```r
usethis::use_course(
  "https://github.com/CorradoLanera/mlt-overview/releases/latest/download/mlt-r-basic.zip"
)
```

Open `mlt-r-basic.Rproj` (its `renv` activates), then `renv::restore()`.
